{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float (already done in prior step, but reconfirm)
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = number of converted orders / total orders in segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values(by='conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Get the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]
best_rate = conversion_rates_sorted['conversion_rate'].iloc[0]

# Print results
conversion_rates_sorted, best_segment, best_rate"}
